newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Vogtle 2 unit seen back Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Vogtle 2 unit seen back Thursday.

text.p: Georgia Power Co's 1,162 megawatt Vogtle nuclear power unit 2 will likely be back at full production Friday after tripping off line Wednesday, a company spokeswoman said.
"It should be back on line at 1100 (EDT Thursday), and should be back at 100 percent within the next 24 hours," spokeswoman Loretto Stevens said Thursday morning.
The Waynesboro, Ga. unit automatically tripped off line due to a minor problem with valve alignment, Stevens said.
The unit was operating at 64 percent of capacity when it tripped off line late Wednesday. Power had been reduced for repairs to a feedwater pump.
The pump has been returned to full operation and the valve problem corrected, Stevens said.
Georgia Power, a subsidiary of Southern Co, is the operator of the Vogtle plant.
